description: External seating and pedestrian barriers to include three tables, twelve chairs and four sections of barrier
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (0000/2019/PL212; 0000/2019/G012
Received:  08 March 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The front external seating and pedestrian barriers hereby approved shall only include the submitted products: 12 x San Antonio (Double Bar) Side Chair (Code:  ICON007-RAL3001); 3 x Box loop tilt & turn 700 square table (Code:  ICON008) and 4 x Heavy Duty Banner Barrier Systems as detailed by drawing 0000/2019/PL212 unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The front external seating and pedestrian barriers hereby approved shall only be sited in front of the existing hot food takeaway unit during its operational hours of 10:30 to 23:00 Monday to Sunday and on Bank Holidays, as set by Planning Permission 00607/211/P4, and shall be fully removed outside of these operational hours under all circumstances.
